name: What should I look for in a contractor for prefab ADU site preparation?
description: Look for experience, local references, permitting knowledge, and transparent pricing in a contractor.

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor for prefab ADU site preparation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for prefab ADU site preparation, look for experience with ADU projects, strong local references, and a clear understanding of permitting requirements in your specific area. Ensure they provide a detailed scope of work and a transparent pricing structure.
